value.rationale: A sharp, natural statistical model-misspecification invariant for two standard ranking families, optimized over all PL rates. It establishes the first nonzero dimension, exact harmonic-number coefficient for every n, best-fit weight direction, and asymptotic cubic growth; this is more than a fixed-size numerical example or a renaming of a qualitative impossibility theorem.
